text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 18th January 1999 by the Board of the Commissioners of Currency, Singapore, are as shown in the Schedule.
